description: This beautifully updated two-bedroom, two-bath, end unit located in sought-after Whiskey Springs offers effortless single-level living in a serene, well maintained complex. Light filled interiors create a warm & inviting atmosphere, featuring a gracious living room with brick fireplace, a dedicated dining area, wonderfully updated kitchen appointed with quartz countertops, new stainless steel appliances, and stylish contemporary light fixtures. Two well-proportioned bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms. Laundry closet in hallway. Sunny patio great for entertaining alfresco. Resort style amenities, including a pool, spa, tennis courts, and beautifully landscaped, pet-friendly grounds. Two dedicated parking spaces side by side. Perfectly positioned just minutes from cafe's, boutique shopping, and waterfront dining in historic downtown Sausalito. Easy access to SF ferry, the Golden Gate Bridge, Muir Woods, Marin Headlands, Stinson beach-placing the very best of Bay Area living within reach. Separate storage closet included. Low Homeowners Association dues only $525 per month.
